name: astral-sh/setup-uv
description: Set up your GitHub Actions workflow with a specific version of uv.

version.description: The version of uv to install e.g., `0.5.0` Defaults to the version in pyproject.toml or 'latest'.

version-file.description: Path to a file containing the version of uv to install. Defaults to searching for uv.toml and if not found pyproject.toml.

python-version.description: The version of Python to set UV_PYTHON to

activate-environment.description: Use uv venv to activate a venv ready to be used by later steps.

working-directory.description: The directory to execute all commands in and look for files such as pyproject.toml

checksum.description: The checksum of the uv version to install

server-url.description: (Deprecated) The server url to use when downloading uv

github-token.description: Used to increase the rate limit when retrieving versions and downloading uv.

enable-cache.description: Enable uploading of the uv cache

cache-dependency-glob.description: Glob pattern to match files relative to the repository root to control the cache.

restore-cache.description: Whether to restore the cache if found.

save-cache.description: Whether to save the cache after the run.

cache-local-path.description: Local path to store the cache.

ignore-nothing-to-cache.description: Ignore when nothing is found to cache.

ignore-empty-workdir.description: Ignore when the working directory is empty.

tool-dir.description: Custom path to set UV_TOOL_DIR to.

tool-bin-dir.description: Custom path to set UV_TOOL_BIN_DIR to.

manifest-file.description: URL to the manifest file containing available versions and download URLs.
